proposedOverrides.summary: Changing southeastern and southern Brazilian coastal atlas umbrella, circa 1500 BCE to 900 CE.

batchIdentityNotes: The exact id and economic display label are preserved as atlas metadata, never treated as an ancient self-name.
The decoded footprint and every geometry signature define scope; famous sites outside its seam appear only as labeled regional comparisons.
Shellmound, sambaqui, coastal, riverine and highland contexts remain distinct, as do Rio de Janeiro, Sao Paulo, Parana and Santa Catarina histories.
Direct finds, microscopic residues, isotopes, radiocarbon models, ancient DNA, historical terminology and living Indigenous knowledge remain separate evidence types.
The 800 contraction and 900 endpoint are atlas seams rather than collapse, extinction or one dated population replacement.
No contemporaneous written sample is supplied because no text securely represents the exact economic umbrella, footprint and interval.
